invariants.rationale: InputEvent event is likely always non-null when entering keyTyped, as it represents the event being processed.
Java chars are unsigned 16-bit and always non-negative, so this is always true at method entry.
event must be an InputEvent by the parameter type at method entry.
It is very uncommon for character to be the all-ones Unicode char in input, suggesting it is likely not this sentinel value.
It is probable that only keyTyped events are passed to this method.
